description: This script contains functions for preparing and managing 'gates' in a CI/CD process, including dependency bootstrap, changelog validation, branch checkout, and conditionally running build, check, and test commands based on changed files. It supports different modes like full, docs-only, and reuse.

methods.name: run_prepare_push_retry_gates
methods.description: Main function to orchestrate the CI/CD gate process, including dependency bootstrap, running build/check/test commands, changelog validation, and environment setup based on changed files and the current PR state.

methods.name: prepare_gates
methods.description: Prepares the gates for a PR by checking out branches, validating changelogs, and conditionally running build, check, and test commands based on the scope of changes, handling different modes such as docs-only or full tests.
